label: Quantinuum Helios - nominal medians

provenance.gates.u1q.fidelity: published: 99.9975% single-qubit fidelity (Quantinuum Helios launch blog, Nov 2025)
provenance.gates.zzmax.fidelity: published: 99.921% two-qubit fidelity across all pairs (Quantinuum Helios launch blog)
provenance.gates.rzz.fidelity: assumed: equal to the published ZZMax fidelity
provenance.readout.fidelity: published: 99.967% SPAM fidelity (Sandia/Quantinuum Helios benchmark); applied as symmetric readout error
provenance.gates.u1q.duration_ns: assumed: order-of-magnitude placeholder; Quantinuum does not publish per-gate durations
provenance.gates.zzmax.duration_ns: assumed: placeholder excluding QCCD ion-transport and cooling time
provenance.coherence: not modelled: hyperfine-qubit T1/T2 are far longer than circuit durations; memory error is folded into gate infidelity
provenance.shot_overhead_us: unknown: per-shot overhead (cooling / state prep / rep delay) is not published; job-time estimates exclude it unless set

note: Nominal device-median values for QPUTwin's noise and gate-duration models. Every field is tagged in 'provenance' as 'published' (with its source) or 'assumed' (placeholder typical of the technology class, NOT vendor data). Replace with a calibration snapshot via QPUTWIN_CALIBRATION before quoting results.
